description: Create a new unmanaged solution (and its publisher if missing) in an environment by packing an empty solution manifest and importing it with pac. Use it to prepare the container before cs_create_agent with solutionName. Requires confirm: true.

confirm.description: Required to actually perform a change in a live environment. Without it the tool returns a dry run.

environment.description: Environment id or URL. Defaults to the active pac auth profile.

workDir.description: Where the manifest and zip are written (default <workspace>/.cs-solutions/<uniqueName>)

name: cs_create_solution
title: Create an unmanaged solution
